item.title: Russell Brand's Lengthy Sentence, Trump's Shock Immigration Deal Comments, and Disgusting Charlie Kirk Attacks, with Emily Jashinsky, Dave Aronberg, and Viva Frei | Ep. 1437 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Dave Aronberg, co-host of "The MK True Crime Show," and Viva Frei, Rumble creator and former litigator, to discuss the breaking news of Russell Brand being given a massive prison sentence of more than 10 years, the judge explaining his decision, the fairness of the prison sentence, the argument that the system was rigged against Russell Brand, the comparison between Russell Brand's sentencing and other criminals in the UK, and more. Then Emily Jashinsky, host of "After Party," joins to discuss a potential immigration deal with the Democrats that sounds like amnesty, the truth about his immigration policy vs. the enforcement of those policies, how the GOP isn’t learning from their 2026 mistakes so far, how neocons aren’t giving up on the Iran war, the focus on "candidate quality" as the new cope, Calley Means going on Joe Rogan and getting honest about what really happened to MAHA, the depressing connections he was exposing between Big Pharma lobbyists and the Trump administration, the leftist podcaster Jennifer Welch making a disgusting comment about Charlie Kirk, how her show is starting to lose advertisers after these comments, and more.
